notes.title: Grammar fix and little more
notes.notes:
Well, I guess when I'm saying "few days" it means "few months", I'm not proud of myself.  But still. I HOPE new text consist less grammar issues, it’s far from perfect, but previous version was just too bad.  BIG THANKS for users of our Discord server in helping to find and fix all mistakes, you can join us as well: https://discord.gg/emNPJPQTfN

What’s new:
-Grammar fix (Duh)
-Fix of few visuals bugs with sprite placement.
-Rephrase few sentences to fit better in the plot (nothing new).
-Made loud sound less loud.
-Added auto-reading feature.
-Optimized the game space requirements.
-Gave a proper "Thank you" image for the people supporting the project.

Next step – Android release.

notes.title: ACT 1
notes.notes:
Yeah... "Few days" he said... Sorry, but today I was working on it for 14+ hours and now it's finally here. Sill rushed despite all delays. But it is what it is. Please show me any bugs or grammar mistakes you'll found on Discord https://discord.gg/TRsT3wSC6U

Enjoy it if you can, I will get to my senses and write a good explanation for delay and my plans for the future in few days. "Few days" Ha-ha. Not funny.

notes.title: Small Fixes and We're BACK TO DEVELOPMENT!
notes.notes:
Long story short - I had to leave my country due to political and economic reasons. Now I'm safe and can work again!

In this update I fixed small grammar errors and added game logo for Linux. It was more just to show that I'm alive than anything.

Next step - current version Android release!
